development_failures_and_corrections: The original 120-second CPU smoke allowance could interrupt valid multi-turn inference; the smoke now bounds the whole interaction at 300 seconds and reports native progress.
An overly specific browser assertion assumed every first search result had a responds_to link; it now checks connected evidence/navigation, including learned_from notes.
The optional resumed smoke retains only marked synthetic data, reuses durable foreground keys, and distinguishes new initiative IDs from old dismissed items.
limits: CPU prompt prefills observed around 55–127 seconds in development runs; this is not a controlled performance benchmark. GPU latency was not measured.
Native scenarios are limited development evidence, not proof of correct behavior for every topic/personality.
Whole-memory restore and end-to-end forgetting controls are not exposed in WebUI.
Synthetic store retained outside the repository only for repeatable local checking.
post_native_display_change: Removed an internal formation-state label from source cards; frontend checks/build passed and daemon was rebuilt. Core/runtime code unchanged after native verification.
